body.p: Claims 11-21 are currently pending. Claims 11 and 14-21 stand rejected. Claims 12-13 stand objected to but have been indicated as reciting allowable subject matter. Claims 11, 15, and 21 have been amended. Claim 12 has been cancelled and incorporated into claim 11. No new matter has been introduced.
Below is a discussion of the 35 U.S.C. § 112(b) rejection of claims 15 and 21, the 35
U.S.C. § 102(a)(1) rejection of claims 11, 14, and 16-18, the 35 U.S.C. § 103 rejection of claims 19-20, and the Allowable Subject Matter.
Favorable reconsideration is respectfully requested in view of the amendments and the following comments.
1. 35 U.S.C. * 112(b) rejection of claims 15 and 21
Claims 15 and 21 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C § 112(b). Claims 15 and 21 have been amended, so it is respectfully requested that this rejection be withdrawn.
2. 35 U.S.C. * 102(a)(1) rejection of claims 11, 14, and 16-18

Claims 11, 14, and 16-18 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C § 102 (a)(1) over U.S. Pat. No. 5,238,810 to Fujiwara et al. (hereinafter, "Fujiwara"). Claim 11 has been amended to incorporate the subject matter of claim 12, which has been indicated as allowable and is cancelled herein. Therefore, the Office Action acknowledges that Fujiwara cannot anticipate amended claim 11 and associated dependent claims 14, and 16-18. Thus, it is respectfully requested that this rejection be withdrawn.
3. 35 U.S.C. * 103 rejection of claims 19

Claim 19 stands rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 over Fujiwara in view of U.S. Pat. Pub. No. 2007/0161116 to Copse (hereinafter, "Copse"). Claim 19 depends from claim 11 and associated dependent claim 18 and is patentable for at least the same reasons as claim 11 (amended to recite allowable subject matter). Accordingly, Fujiwara in view of Copse fails to
render amended claim 11, as well as associated dependent claim 19, obvious to one having ordinary skill in the art. Thus, it is respectfully requested that this rejection be withdrawn.
4. 35 U.S.C. * 103 rejection of claims 20

Claim 20 stands rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 over Fujiwara in view of U.S. Pat. No. 11,698,381 to Benelmekki Erretby (hereinafter, "Benelmekki Erretby"). Claim 20 depends from claim 11 and is patentable for at least the same reasons as claim 11 (amended to recite allowable subject matter). Accordingly, Fujiwara in view of Benelmekki Erretby fails to render amended claim 11, as well as associated dependent claim 20, obvious to one having ordinary skill in the art. Thus, it is respectfully requested that this rejection be withdrawn.
5. Allowable Subject Matter
The Office Action indicates that claims 12-13 would be allowable if rewritten in independent form to include the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims.
Claim 11 has been amended to recite the allowable subject matter of claim 12 and claim 12 has been cancelled herein.
Thus, amended claim 11, as well as associated dependent claims 13-21, are in condition for allowance.
Although no fees are associated with the filing of this paper, please charge any deficiency or credit any overpayment in the fees for this matter to our Deposit Account No. 20-0090.
